project_type: FastAPI async backend + Celery workers + Next.js frontend (Docker Compose). Self-hosted AI business platform using Claude Code CLI subprocess. No separate backend/ subdirectory — all Python source lives at the project root.
build_system: No build step for Python. Docker Compose builds images from project root (Dockerfile at root). QUIRK: CLAUDE.md says 'cd backend' but there is NO backend/ directory — all commands run from the project root /Users/gauravshewale/Development/business/NFC/polsia.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), pytest-mock, httpx AsyncClient. testpaths=["tests"]. Integration tests use testcontainers (marked 'integration').
build_command: No compile step. Python is run directly.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'CLAUDE_CLI_MOCK=true python -m pytest tests/unit/ -v' from the project root. 2. All 40+ unit tests must pass. 3. No duplicate fixture warnings. 4. Coverage: 'CLAUDE_CLI_MOCK=true python -m pytest tests/unit/ --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing' — target 75%+ per pyproject.toml.
environment_constraints: CLAUDE_CLI_MOCK=true must be set for all tests — prevents real Claude CLI subprocess calls. SANDBOX_MODE=true prevents real API calls. The root conftest.py (/polsia/conftest.py) is a duplicate of tests/conftest.py and must be DELETED before running tests to avoid duplicate fixture errors.
contribution_requirements: 1. Never use postgresql.JSONB or postgresql.ARRAY in ORM models — use sa.JSON for SQLite compatibility in unit tests. 2. Never import chromadb at module level — lazy import inside get_collection() body only. 3. Never call await db.commit() in API handlers — get_db() auto-commits. 4. Always patch where the name is used: patch app.services.memory_service.get_collection, not app.core.chroma_client.get_collection (also need to patch both per conftest). 5. mock_redis patches app.core.redis_client.get_redis AND app.core.events.get_redis — both paths must exist.
key_patterns: 1. ORM models: sa.Column style (not Mapped[] annotations), Python-side defaults (default=X not only server_default), sa.JSON for all dict/list columns. 2. Services: async functions, take AsyncSession as first arg, use db.flush()+db.refresh() to populate server fields before returning, caller commits. 3. API: APIRouter with prefix, Depends(require_api_key) for auth, jsonable_encoder(_row(obj)) for ORM serialization. 4. Agents: inherit BasePolsiaAgent, set agent_type class var, implement run(task, context)->dict with at least {summary, result}. 5. Tests use api_client fixture which overrides get_db with the test SQLite session and sets settings.api_key='test-key'.
directory_structure: polsia/ — project root (also the Python working directory). celery_app/ — Celery worker, config, beat schedule, tasks (agent_tasks.py, daily_cycle.py). alembic/ — migrations (0001_initial_schema.py has all 16 table definitions). tests/ — conftest.py + unit/ (api/, celery/, service tests) + integration/. scripts/ — seed_company.py. frontend/ — Next.js dashboard. nginx/ — nginx.conf. app/ — DOES NOT EXIST YET, must be created entirely.
